title: Components
description: The components the conformance cases need, each by its ID, with the issue that builds it and whether it is built. The runner skips a case while a component it needs isn't built, and the issue that builds a component sets its built to true.

propertyNames.description: A component's ID, in lowercase kebab-case.

description.description: What the component is, in one or two sentences of plain text. Text between backticks renders as code.

issue.description: The number of the GitHub issue that builds it.

built.description: Whether it is built, so that the cases that need it run.
